title: [review] prefix-authz P3 bundle: delegate() validation, mask guard, CountingStorage delete, dup-gate decision doc, test polish
description: P3 bundle from wave-5 review: (1) delegate() (routing.rs:205-230) accepts ::/128 and non-0200::/8 prefixes (fe80::/64, ff02::/16, Ipv6Addr::UNSPECIFIED) - spec 05-routing.md:468 expects exact primary 02xx addresses; reject UNSPECIFIED and non-0200::/8 in delegate(). (2) mask_prefix_bits (routing.rs:253-262) panics for prefix_len 129..=255 (prefix[full] OOB) - both current call sites validate first, but add debug_assert!(prefix_len <= 128) or early return. (3) CountingStorage in tests/dao_prefix_authorization.rs:228-230 forwards delete without incrementing writes - NonVolatile includes delete as a mutator; count it so the zero-mutation proof covers all mutation classes. (4) Document the duplicate-retransmission decision: duplicate DAO re-runs the gate at routing.rs:646, so a delegation revoked between original and retransmission turns Duplicate into RouteRejected (fail-closed, spec 8.6 idempotency satisfied) - record as intended decision in code comment or spec 8.7.1 note. (5) rx_state snapshot in tests uses format!({:?}) string equality - derive PartialEq on DaoRxState for exact zero-mutation assertion. (6) Missing tests: full-pipeline padded prefix_len=64 target case; all-delegated (no origin target) DAO must be rejected (policy lives in sender_is_authorized found_origin, routing.rs:736-759 - pin it); non-byte-aligned /63 masking case. (7) Track for .44.9: delegation record lacks 8.7.2 mandated E-flag and sequence-authority dimensions (routing.rs:196 stores only (u8,[u8;16]); delegation expiry also missing - both fail-closed today, list as known divergences until delegation delivery ships).
